Class ArrayFill

java.lang.Object
org.apache.commons.lang3.ArrayFill
public final class ArrayFill extends Object
Fills and returns arrays in the fluent style.
Since:
3.14.0

    • clear

      public static char[] clear(char[] a, int fromIndex, int toIndex)
      Fills and returns the given array, assigning '\0' to each element of the array.

      Equivalent to: 

      ArrayFill.fill(a, fromIndex, toIndex, '\0'); // and not '0'!
      Parameters:
      a - The array to fill (may be null).
      fromIndex - The index of the first element (inclusive) to be filled with '\0'.
      toIndex - The index of the last element (exclusive) to be filled with '\0'.
      Returns:
      The given array.
      Since:
      3.21.0
      See Also:

    • fill

      public static <T, E extends Throwable> T[] fill(T[] array, FailableIntFunction<? extends T, E> generator) throws E
      Fills and returns the given array, using the provided generator function to compute each element. Like Arrays.setAll(Object[], IntFunction) with exception support.

      If the generator function throws an exception, it is relayed to the caller and the array is left in an indeterminate state.

      If the input array or generator function is null, nothing happens.

      Type Parameters:
      T - type of elements of the array.
      E - The kind of thrown exception or error.
      Parameters:
      array - array to fill (may be null).
      generator - A function accepting an index and producing the desired value for that position.
      Returns:
      The input array.
      Throws:
      E - Thrown by the given generator.
      Since:
      3.18.0
      See Also:
      • Arrays.setAll(Object[], IntFunction)
